title: Boss: festival launch sprint
concept: Several PRs, one conflict, one review

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: It's launch day! Handle a PR, fix a conflict, and merge.

hints: This is the boss level. Use everything you learned about PRs.
Create branches, push, open PRs, handle reviews and conflicts.
Answer the question to complete the sprint.

questions.prompt: What is the best way to handle multiple tasks?

choices.text: One branch per task, one PR per task

recap: One branch, one task, one PR.
